title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Unauthenticated SQL injection in frontend data view filters in Visforms extension…
description: An unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability exists in the frontend data view filters of the Visforms Joomla extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. The sorting, location radius, and published filters do not properly sanitize user input, allowing attackers to inject SQL commands without authentication.
